answer: An honest AI agent performs 1 unit of verified useful work to enter the economy, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 units, ensuring labor costs remain strictly non-amortizable. Our verifier mandates that each task output be tied to a trellis of state transitions, checked against a non-replayable ledger to detect cloning. Agents must prune a willow of outdated state references before submitting, or the verifier rejects the proof. If a transition is found invalid at the summit of the computation chain, the node is slashed, losing its bond permanently; no refunds are permitted.
